tax.text: Mullin says he backs a progressive tax code where corporations and the wealthiest pay more, and advocates funding childcare and the expanded Child Tax Credit.
tax.quote: I support a progressive, equitable tax code that keeps costs down for working families while ensuring that large corporations and the wealthiest 1% pay their fair share.

wages.text: Mullin describes himself as pro-labor and committed to expanding union jobs.
wages.quote: I am proudly pro-labor and will always fight for the expansion of well-paying union jobs.

debt.text: Mullin praised protecting Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid from cuts in the 2023 budget agreement.
debt.quote: I commend President Biden for his leadership in fending off devastating cuts and protecting Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.

housing.text: Mullin lists producing new housing and addressing affordability as a top congressional priority.
housing.quote: Addressing affordability challenges and the production of new housing is one of my major priorities in Congress.

schools.text: Mullin says he strongly supports and has invested in public schools and universities.
schools.quote: I am a strong advocate for public primary, secondary, and higher education institutions.

immigration.text: Mullin voted no on DHS/ICE funding and condemned the administration's aggressive immigration enforcement operations.
immigration.quote: The Trump Administration's deployment of masked, poorly-trained ICE agents into American cities has led to violence, intimidation, and serious violations of Americans' constitutional rights

guns.text: Mullin called for stronger gun-safety laws to address gun violence.
guns.quote: Congress must take meaningful action to strengthen protections for places of worship and address the epidemic of gun violence through stronger gun safety laws.

abortion.text: Mullin says he believes in a woman's right to choose and cosponsors legislation to protect abortion access nationwide.
abortion.quote: I unequivocally believe in a woman's right to choose and will continue fighting against policies that restrict access to reproductive health care and endanger women's health.

gender.text: Mullin opposed laws barring transgender girls and women from school sports teams matching their gender identity.
gender.quote: states’ discriminatory laws banning transgender girls and women from playing on school athletic teams that match their gender identity

health.text: Mullin is a member of the Medicare for All Caucus and describes health care as a human right for everyone regardless of income.
health.quote: High quality, affordable health care is a human right. We must ensure quality health care is available to everyone in this country regardless of income.

energy.text: Mullin supports the Green New Deal and federal investments in clean-energy technologies and infrastructure to reduce emissions.
energy.quote: Kevin is a proud cosponsor of the Green New Deal, which would safeguard our planet for future generations and reduce emissions

voting.text: Mullin supported expanding ballot access and helped enact universal vote-by-mail and automatic voter registration in California.
voting.quote: In the California Assembly, Kevin authored the landmark California DISCLOSE Act, to put a stop to the use of dark money in our elections and reveal the true funders of ballot measures and candidates. He helped pass universal vote-by-mail so every California voter receives a postage paid paper ballot, resulting in record participation and turnout. He was also a co-author of the law to automatically register Californians to vote.

tax.text: Hoelter says he will pursue lower taxes, reduced government spending, and pro-business policies.
tax.quote: Charles will fight for lower taxes, reduced government spending, and pro-business policies that create jobs and increase opportunity.

safety.text: Hoelter supports law enforcement and policies that protect communities and hold criminals accountable.
safety.quote: Charles supports law enforcement and believes in policies that protect communities and hold criminals accountable.

immigration.text: Hoelter says immigration should be legal, fair, and controlled and describes border security as a national-security issue.
immigration.quote: Charles believes immigration should be legal, fair, and controlled. A secure border is a national security issue and must be treated as one

guns.text: Hoelter says he will defend the constitutional right to bear arms.
guns.quote: Charles will always defend the Constitution, including freedom of speech, religious liberty, and the right to bear arms.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Hoelter says he is working to keep men out of women’s sports.
gender.quote: Working on keeping men out of women sports

energy.text: On his campaign site, Hoelter says he supports increasing American energy production to lower costs and reduce reliance on foreign nations.
energy.quote: Charles supports American energy production to lower costs and reduce reliance on foreign nations

voting.text: Hoelter lists requiring voter ID at elections and cleaning up voter rolls in all states among his top objectives.
voting.quote: impose term limits on politicians, require voter ID at elections
